redraw_s05.ruling_closer_reading: WHU-S05's drawn review (Cochrane CD005632.pub4) fails closer reading. Its full text is not openly available, and the Cochrane Library / Wiley terms (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/terms-and-conditions) forbid using AI tools to ingest, analyse or process material from the site. So no answer key can lawfully be drafted from it. The protocol's rule applies: "If a drawn entry fails eligibility on closer reading, the next in the shuffle is taken, and the reason is logged."
redraw_s05.ruling_openness_check: OPTION 2. Openness is established by Europe PMC metadata, not by Crossref or any Wiley page. The rule, fixed before any candidate is checked: an entry is eligible for the S05 re-draw only if (i) Europe PMC lists the review with an open licence (CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND) in its license field, AND (ii) Europe PMC's fullTextXML service returns the full text. Check (ii) by HTTP status and content type only; do not read or save the text. (iii) The entry must also pass eligibility criteria 1-5 as before.
redraw_s05.openness_check_note: Changed from the first ruling's check (Cochrane Library page or Crossref licence field): Crossref's licence field is empty for every Cochrane review checked (the first 25 in this shuffle, and WHU-S01's review, which Europe PMC lists as CC BY-NC), and the Cochrane Library pages are on the Wiley site whose terms the ruling rests on. The rule was fixed before any candidate was evaluated against it.
